justify_why_gaps_are_missing.justification: Top flow-cytometry scatter plots use continuous fluorescence axes (Annexin V FITC) with regular tick/scale and the bottom panel is categorical (treatment groups) — no omitted numeric ranges or sudden jump in tick spacing that would require a break marker.

Top flow-cytometry scatter plots use continuous fluorescence axes (PI PE) with regular tick/scale and the bottom bar graph y-axis shows percentage values with evenly spaced ticks; there are no skipped ranges or visual discontinuities requiring an axis break.

Top flow-cytometry plots use continuous fluorescence axes (Annexin V) with consistent tick spacing; bottom bar chart x-axis is categorical. No numeric jumps or spacing anomalies visible that would require a break indicator.
Y-axes in the bar chart show percentage values with regular tick spacing and no skipped ranges; flow plots' y-axes (PI) are continuous and show no abrupt scale discontinuity.
Heatmap x-axis lists gene labels (categorical) rather than a continuous numeric axis; no axis break is applicable.
Heatmap y-axis lists samples/conditions (categorical) and color scale is continuous (colorbar) without any omitted numeric ranges; no axis break marker is needed.
X-axes are categorical (gene names/groups) for the bar charts; axis breaks are not applicable.
Y-axes show relative mRNA levels or percentages with regular tick spacing and no skipped numeric ranges or abrupt changes in scale that would require a break indicator.
